items.relevance: 直接连接遗忘、再激活、记忆重构与错误记忆机制。主要局限是果蝇回路和厌恶条件化范式不能直接外推到人类情景记忆；复杂自传体错误记忆仍涉及更高层级系统。
items.summary: 研究用果蝇厌恶记忆范式、提醒线索和神经回路操控，发现被遗忘的记忆并未消失，而是保存在行为中性的蘑菇体输出神经元静默痕迹中。提醒可重建原有输出痕迹并恢复真实记忆；误导性提醒则可能结合既有经历形成虚假记忆。真实恢复与虚假形成都依赖情境，并由可分离的多巴胺通路门控。
items.summary_en: Using aversive-memory paradigms, reminder cues and circuit manipulations in Drosophila, the study found that forgotten memories persist as silent traces in behaviourally neutral mushroom-body output neurons. Reminders reinstated the original trace and recovered memory, whereas misleading cues could distort reconstruction into false memories. Both outcomes were context dependent and gated by separable dopaminergic pathways.
items.title: 从遗忘信息中恢复真实记忆并形成虚假记忆
items.title_en: Creating true and false memories from forgotten information in Drosophila

items.location: 决策／信息寻求／眶额皮层
items.relevance: 把好奇心／信息寻求、价值计算和低维神经动力学连接起来。主要限制是任务用气味和水奖励操作“内在信息价值”，仍可能混入不确定性降低或条件强化；小鼠 OFC 结果不能直接等同于人类知识好奇心。
items.summary: 研究建立气味线索的信息寻求任务：即使信息不改变最终奖励，小鼠仍选择获取信息，并愿意牺牲部分水奖励。微型内窥镜记录显示，OFC 群体逐渐形成区分“信息价值”和“水奖励价值”的表征；潜变量模型在低维群体动力学中复现了这种分离。
items.summary_en: An odour-based information-seeking task showed that mice chose information even when it could not change the reward outcome and were willing to sacrifice water reward to obtain it. Microendoscopic OFC recordings revealed distinct population representations for information-predictive and water-reward-predictive cues, which a latent-variable model recapitulated in low-dimensional dynamics.
items.title: 小鼠眶额皮层表征信息的内在价值
items.title_en: Representations of the intrinsic value of information in mouse orbitofrontal cortex

items.location: 人类内侧颞叶／自然情境电生理／开放数据
items.relevance: 这是自然情境人类单元记录、语义记忆和机器学习复现的高价值开放数据入口。局限是临床癫痫样本、植入位置由治疗需要决定，29 人的覆盖不均；它是数据资源与技术验证，不是关于记忆机制的单一因果结论。
items.summary: SUMMER 数据集收录 29 名颅内植入患者完整观看 83 分钟电影时，杏仁核、海马、内嗅皮层、海马旁皮层等区域 2,286 个神经元的放电。数据采用 Neurodata Without Borders 格式，并提供逐帧角色、地点、镜头切换和对白等标注、单元波形、定位信息、机器学习就绪版本及示例代码；作者展示了电影特征调谐和群体活动解码。
items.summary_en: SUMMER contains activity from 2,286 neurons in the amygdala, hippocampus, entorhinal and parahippocampal cortices and neighbouring structures from 29 intracranially implanted patients watching an 83-minute feature film. It includes frame-wise narrative and visual annotations, spike times, waveforms and electrode locations in Neurodata Without Borders format, plus machine-learning-ready data and example decoding code.
items.title: SUMMER：29 名患者观看完整电影时的 2,286 个单神经元数据集
items.title_en: Human neuron activity during an 83-minute movie from 2,286 neurons and 29 patients

items.location: 计算神经生理／LFP／海马 CA1
items.relevance: 与海马振荡、电生理信号解释和计算建模高度相关。核心限制是结果来自单个形态学神经元模型，而真实 LFP 汇集多细胞、多层和多种突触交互；这些可检验预测仍需网络模拟与体内实验验证。
items.summary: 研究在具主动树突的形态与生物物理真实神经元模型中模拟化学突触和缝隙连接输入。同步化学输入在近端电极产生负偏转及细胞外偶极子，而缝隙连接输入产生正偏转、无偶极子，并在高频节律输入下更强抑制 LFP 功率且改变 spike–LFP 相位；HCN 通道触发的外向电流是关键机制。eLife 评价为“有价值、证据令人信服”。
items.summary_en: Biophysically detailed active-dendrite models were used to compare extracellular potentials generated by chemical synaptic and gap-junction inputs. Synchronous chemical inputs produced proximal negative deflections and extracellular dipoles, while gap-junction inputs produced positive deflections without dipoles, suppressed high-frequency LFP power more strongly and altered spike–LFP phase. Outward currents through HCN channels were central. eLife rated the work valuable with compelling evidence.
items.title: 主动树突化学突触与缝隙连接产生相反的细胞外信号特征
items.title_en: Dichotomy between extracellular signatures of active dendritic chemical synapses and gap junctions

A bachelor's or master's in computer science, biomedical engineering or a close field is accepted. items.relevance: 把继任表征、行为偏置与海马—下托空间编码连接起来，直接对应计算认知、强化学习表征和神经数据模型比较。
items.summary: 研究询问为何海马主要输出区下托会出现边界细胞、角点细胞等异质空间反应。作者把啮齿动物行为偏置纳入 successor representation，并与纯空间和边界向量模型比较；模型更好复现多类下托放电，并提示下托比 CA1 编码更长时间尺度的预测表征。限制是证据来自啮齿动物数据与模型拟合，依赖行为策略和模型假设，不能证明神经回路直接实现该算法；当前为 early-access 版本。
items.summary_en: By incorporating rodent behavioural biases into a successor representation and comparing it with spatial and boundary-vector models, the study reproduced diverse subicular firing patterns and inferred a longer predictive horizon than CA1. The evidence is model-based and rodent-specific, depends on behavioural-policy assumptions, and does not prove literal neural implementation; this is an early-access version.
items.title: 下托空间编码可由预测映射与行为偏置统一解释
items.title_en: Subicular spatial codes arise from predictive mapping

items.relevance: 把心率减速、MEG 神经解码、威胁—奖励整合和决策联系起来，适合认知神经科学、多模态生理信号与时序解码方向。
items.summary: 研究结合高精度 MEG、威胁诱发心率减速和威胁／奖励神经信息解码，发现更强的心率减速伴随威胁与奖励对选择的影响增强；解码信号在反应前数秒预测选择，并在防御状态下更强地与背侧前扣带低频活动同步。限制是人类证据主要为生理—神经—行为关联，不能单独确立心脏状态导致价值表征变锐的因果方向，仍需跨任务与临床群体复现。
items.summary_en: Combining high-precision MEG, threat-induced cardiac deceleration and neural decoding, the study found stronger cardiac slowing accompanied greater threat/reward weighting; decoded signals predicted choices seconds before response and synchronized more strongly with dorsal anterior cingulate activity. The human evidence is mainly correlational and cannot establish causal direction; replication is needed.
items.title: 防御性心脏状态增强决策中的神经价值表征
items.title_en: Defensive cardiac states sharpen neural value representations during decision making

items.relevance: 提供新的空间转录组与动力学方法，连接脑区异质性、电休克刺激反应、计算建模和神经生物信息分析。
items.summary: 研究开发 spatial NT-seq，以无需转基因的代谢标记和原位化学重编码同时定位新生与既有 RNA。应用于小鼠脑后，作者发现齿状回是高 RNA 周转热点，并描绘电休克刺激后的脑区特异转录及转录后反应；计算模型寻找影响 mRNA 稳定性的序列和调控因子。限制是核心空间实验仅 6 只成年小鼠、每条件 2 只，小鼠和电休克结果不能直接等同人类抑郁治疗机制。
items.summary_en: Spatial NT-seq combines transgenesis-free metabolic labelling with in-situ recoding to co-map new and existing RNA. In mouse brain it identified the dentate gyrus as a turnover hotspot, resolved region-specific responses to electroconvulsive stimulation, and modelled determinants of mRNA stability. The core spatial experiment used six adult mice, two per condition, and cannot be equated directly with human depression treatment mechanisms.
items.title: 空间 NT-seq 绘制小鼠脑 RNA 周转动力学
items.title_en: Spatial mapping of RNA turnover kinetics in the mouse brain

A bachelor's honours degree in psychology, cognitive neuroscience, neuroscience, education or a related field is required; cognitive/neuropsychological assessment, child or school research, fMRI/fNIRS and ethics experience are preferred. items.title_en: Research Assistant — AI for Seismic Data Analysis

items.relevance: 连接帕金森病、外周转录表达、生物标志物、统计建模和一级亲属风险研究；适合神经退行性疾病与生物信息方向。
items.summary: 研究以 RT-qPCR 测量 123 名帕金森病患者、一级亲属和健康对照的外周血 VEGFA mRNA，并用 ANOVA、相关、回归与 ROC 分析。患者与一级亲属总体表达高于对照；≤60 岁探索性亚组 AUC 为 0.897。限制是外周单基因、横断面设计与探索性年龄分层，样本量有限且置信区间较宽，不能作为已验证诊断标志物，需独立纵向复现。
items.summary_en: Peripheral-blood VEGFA mRNA was measured by RT-qPCR in 123 participants with Parkinson's disease, first-degree relatives and healthy controls, then analysed with ANOVA, correlation, regression and ROC methods. Patients and relatives showed higher expression; the exploratory <=60 subgroup yielded AUC 0.897. The single peripheral marker, cross-sectional design, exploratory age stratification, modest sample and wide confidence interval preclude diagnostic use without independent longitudinal validation.
items.title: 帕金森病患者与一级亲属的 VEGFA 外周表达升高
items.title_en: VEGFA gene expression in Parkinson's disease and first-degree relatives

items.relevance: 连接人机交互、运动控制、康复机器人和纵向协调分析，提示穿戴式机器人适应效应可能在移除后持续。
items.summary: 研究比较多日重复外骨骼力场暴露后的肩—肘协调变化，发现不同力场导致不同适应轨迹，且部分协调改变在装置移除后仍持续，挑战“影响会立即消失”的假设。限制是样本量小，组间基线正式等效性未建立；效应依赖特定装置、任务和低幅力场，尚不能直接推广到临床康复或长期日常使用。
items.summary_en: Across repeated multi-day exposure to exoskeleton force fields, shoulder-elbow coordination followed condition-specific adaptation trajectories and some changes persisted after device removal, challenging the assumption of immediate washout. The sample was small and formal baseline equivalence was not established; effects are specific to the device, task and low-magnitude fields and cannot yet be generalised to clinical rehabilitation or long-term everyday use.
items.title: 重复使用外骨骼会留下持续的肩—肘协调改变
items.title_en: Repetitive exoskeleton use induces persistent coordination changes

items.summary_en: A full-time PhD within the NASCE ERC Synergy project, studying representations of natural auditory scenes across the brain and artificial neural networks. The role combines 7T fMRI acquisition/analysis, deep-learning and NeuroAI models, multivariate/representational modelling of behavioural-brain-model data, and reproducible pipelines. A relevant master's is required. Practical experience is needed in either neuroimaging or AI/ML—not both—together with motivation to train in the complementary field, plus Python, statistics and C1 English. Applications close on 20 September; the initial 12-month contract can extend for the full PhD after positive evaluation, with €3,204–4,051 gross monthly salary. The official page does not state a posting date, so this first discovery is conservatively recorded as a historical backfill.

items.relevance: 对 EEG／MEG／LFP 数据分析具有直接方法意义：提醒不要把未归一化的跨试次方差误当作独立于功率的神经变异指标。
items.summary: 研究重新检验连续脑信号的“跨试次变异”指标，分析两套 LFP 与一套 EEG 数据。作者发现，在事件相关电位之外，跨试次方差几乎等同于试次内方差，而后者就是信号功率；ERP 出现时两者相关才下降。论文提出以功率变异系数 CV(power) 作为均值归一化的独立指标，并将其解释为功率信噪比的倒数。限制是结论来自三套既有数据，跨物种、脑区、任务和预处理流程的普适性仍需更广泛验证；新指标的实际增益也需在外部数据与预测任务中确认。
items.summary_en: Reanalysis of two LFP datasets and one EEG dataset showed that, outside event-related potentials, across-trial variance is nearly identical to within-trial variance, which is signal power. The relationship weakens during ERPs. The authors propose CV(power), a mean-normalised coefficient of variation related to inverse power signal-to-noise ratio, as a more independent variability measure. The conclusion rests on three datasets, so generalisation across species, regions, tasks and preprocessing pipelines—and the practical predictive value of the new metric—requires broader external validation.
